I lead an interdisciplinary research group in data science at the Institute for Ecological Economics, WU Vienna. With a background in Computational Modelling (MSc) and Earth System Science (PhD), my main research interests are in developing new algorithms and software architectures to meet the scalability requirements of complex spatio-temporal geodata and earth observation. My research is supported by competitive national and international funding, most notably an ERC Consolidator Grant. Among my key contributions are the development of the Time-Weighted Dynamic Time Warping (TWDTW) algorithm for time series classification and the enabling of global-scale analysis, which revealed previously overlooked environmental footprints of mining worldwide. By focusing on the engineering of new algorithms and high-performance software systems, my team provides the essential tools and empirical insights needed to monitor global environmental change and support evidence-based sustainability decisions.

```{python}

#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'
#| cache: true

import requests
import urllib3
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# Silence SSL warnings
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# DOIs list
DOIS = [
    "10.1016/j.jclepro.2025.147437",
    "10.1038/d41586-023-04090-3", 
    "10.1038/s41597-022-01547-4",
    "10.1109/jstars.2016.2517118",
]

def get_citation_from_doi(doi):
    """Fetches citation data from CrossRef."""
    url = f"https://api.crossref.org/v1/works/{doi}"
    
    headers = {'Accept': 'application/json'}
    
    try:
        headers['User-Agent'] = 'VictorMausWebsite (mailto:your.email@example.com)'
        
        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, verify=False, timeout=10)
        response.raise_for_status()
        
        data = response.json().get('message', {})
        title = data.get('title', ['No Title'])[0]
        
        # Get year safely
        date_parts = data.get('issued', {}).get('date-parts', [[None]])
        year = date_parts[0][0] if date_parts else None
        
        # Handle journal title list safely
        container = data.get('container-title', [])
        journal = container[0] if container else None
        
        # --- FIXED: Use HTML with target="_blank" instead of Markdown links ---
        citation_text = f'**<a href="https://doi.org/{doi}" target="_blank">{title}</a>**'
        
        if journal:
            citation_text += f", *{journal}*"
        if year:
            citation_text += f" ({year})"
            
        return f'{citation_text}'
            
    except Exception as e:
        # --- FIXED: Added target="_blank" to error link as well ---
        return f'* Error fetching citation: {e}. See: <a href="https://doi.org/{doi}" target="_blank">doi.org/{doi}</a>'

# --- Main Execution ---
display(Markdown("## Selected Publications\n"))

for doi in DOIS:
    res = get_citation_from_doi(doi)
    display(Markdown(res))

```
